With guard input the controlled defender slides at topSpeed × lerp(0.82,0.95,prd) (sprint at the edge on his burst bar), facing the ball; with no input existing defend() logic plays him (assist). switchDefender(p, to?) = nearest defender to the ball or a tapped one. reachIn(p) STEAL: in front/side of the ball hand within 3 ft, chance by STL vs HND and the dribble beat; else a whiff (0.35 s off-balance) or a reach-in foul (higher when repeated within 1 s, feeds nba-5's bonus); cooldown 0.6 s. jumpContest(p) CONTEST/BLOCK: a jump timed to the release from <= 4 ft grades the contest one tier heavier and adds block chance by BLK, VRT, height and timing; early jumps leave him landing (make-him-land); contact on a late jump can be a shooting foul. AI offense pump-fakes a defender who leaves his feet early. Scheme adds 'drop' (screener's defender stays back near the rim on a pick) and 'zone' (2-3 spots by ball position); schemeFor weights by the offense's shooting and handling; Hoops2 LOOK_TEXT/TIP extended. BOARD timing both ends: on a miss the controlled player shows a ring filling toward the ideal jump moment (ball dropping through his max reach minus his time to peak); jumping in the 120 ms before it is a green board (+25% reach-race radius), ratings/height/position still decide; AI rebounders time with skill noise; event 'board-green'. Hoops2 defense HUD: CONTEST 92 px (tap jump, hold hands up), STEAL 64, SWITCH 52, teal ring under your defender, the AI shooter's live % visible, DEFENSE banner; renderer.setKits() swaps kits per possession. Lab.tsx one-line '?arcade&def' to start a defensive possession for QA.

Drop: screener's man >= 8 ft nearer the rim than the screen at the pick; zone: each defender within 6 ft of his spot with the ball on the perimeter; green board raises reach radius by 25% and nothing else

Scripted user-defender policies over 600 AI possessions (Pro): idle-assist PPP 1.08–1.18; good contester <= idle − 0.05; early jumper >= idle + 0.05; steal spammer draws more fouls/FTs and PPP >= idle

result.notes:
Plan committed and pushed: /home/user/ps-s-nba/docs/studio-overhaul/nba-plan.md (commit fc7657b on claude/studio-nba). Only the plan file was committed; no code changed. The team doc /home/user/ps-s-nba/docs/studio-overhaul/nba.md is created by task nba-1.

Things the build engineers and the lead should know:
1. Conflict in the research, and how the plan settles it: the touch window table (§5.1.2: 70–85 ms elite, 45–55 ms average) together with "a green always goes in" gives an elite open shooter with a good thumb about 60–68% on open threes. That is above the research's own per-shot target of 48–52% (§5.1.6). The plan keeps the brief's windows and the green rule, sets per-shot targets at σ = 45 ms (the existing curve-test convention), and keeps the box score realistic through the contest mix, the AI's release spread and a steeper fall-off outside the window. This divergence is recorded for nba.md.
2. Protocol: one running line for the lead, "Protocol bump needed: NBA draft 10→11, UT NBA 10→11". Every engine task (nba-3 through nba-10) adds its reason. NFL and soccer are untouched by nba. The shared forfeit field in Arcade.tsx does nothing unless a sport's game component calls it.
3. Saves: no profile or storage-key changes. The only new storage is a per-device prefs key, perfect-season:hoops-prefs:v1, with a test for missing, corrupt or old-shape data. The new Hooper, HoopsGame, Possession and Progress fields are optional and never saved. New possession marks ('4', 'F0'–'F3') go on the wire but are not persisted. I checked that `ends` only feed the result screen and the debrief.
4. Small hunks outside the nba lane, planned and to be listed in nba.md:

missing: OWNER DECISION 2 conflict, not escalated. BRIEF owner decision 2 and STREAM NBA-07 both list Moments, Gauntlet and draft season/playoff games among the solo games where defense is played by default. Plan §6 #15-16 quietly defers them. The plan is factually right that Gauntlet.tsx, engine/season.ts playSeason() and playoffs are rating sims with no arcade match, and that Moments are Hoops2 `practice` drills. But a binding owner decision cannot be closed as 'Deferred'. Fix: write it in nba.md as an owner-decision conflict for the lead with options. At minimum, nba can ship a Hoops2 `practice.drill` 'defend' ('get N stops') mode so ut can add a defensive Moment.

NBA-06: the plan misses tie paths. (1) UT simBoth (ut/Match.tsx:835-923) runs both sides through aiPossessionsOf(POSSESSIONS), and a tie still goes to decide() by squad rating (ut/play.ts:70-80). (2) The Arcade kickoff 'SIM IT'. (3) The online takeover finishedFrom() truncates ends to TOTAL (Arcade.tsx:60). The plan only extends the solo race and the online race. The tie copy also needs ut handoffs: 'A tie goes to the better squad' (Match.tsx ~1449) and 'Tied on points: the better team (by rating) takes it' (ui/Results.tsx:250).

Practice-mode regressions are unplanned (Training Camp `src/evolution/Training.tsx` and Moments). Moments score `green: ls?.greened` (Hoops2.tsx:369). 'nba:green-room' pays a gold pack for 2 greens in 5 (ut/moments.ts:82-92). nba-4 widens windows and makes heavy/smothered never greened. nba-3 turns a <120 ms SHOOT tap into a pump fake. nba-5 adds FT trips. Needed: (a) practice mode excludes fouls/FT trips, OT, alternation, play cards and pips; (b) shoot/finish/pass drills still count attempts; (c) before/after completion rates per NBA Moment, handed to ut.

NBA-05 second fix is missing. Pre-1980 `thr` still comes from FT touch (hoops2/ratings.ts:113 `l.from < 1980`). The plan only scales three-point appetite ×0.1, so 1960s/70s fives still take threes. That is a rating change and a protocol bump, and per owner decision 5 any displayed change must be documented. The era targets also cover only 3PA rate, pace and FT rate. They omit PPP, TOV and ORB by era (research §4.7: 1985-86 1.07 PPP / 2.8 TOV / 2.2 ORB per 16 vs 2024-25 1.145 / 2.3 / 1.8).

Audit §5 AI weaknesses are not addressed. (1) No box-outs. (2) Every defender runs to the exact landing spot the moment a miss is decided (engine.ts:1284), and the offense's rebounder gets the same help (988-989). This perfect-information rebounding survives nba-5's real miss endpoints and nba-8's BOARD timing. (3) The AI offense never uses SPIN, CUT or SPACE and has no set post-up. Its plays must matter now that the user picks defensive looks.

No camera design for defensive possessions. The behind-the-shooter camera (render.ts:412-419) depth-sorts by cx (render.ts:719-756). On defense the user's own defender stands between the AI handler and the rim, so the AI handler will hide him: NBA-20 in reverse. Needed: a framing rule (lateral offset or pitch on defense) and an occlusion target for the controlled defender.

SHOOT has no context table. It is already BOARD in rebound races (docs/CORE-GAMEPLAY.md:13). nba-3 makes tap = pump fake and swipes left/right/down/up/circle = cross/cross/step-back/spin/spin. nba-10 reuses swipe down = floater (in the paint) and swipe up = dunk (attacking). nba-8 turns the slot into CONTEST on defense. 'Down' and 'up' each carry two meanings, and 'up' and 'circle' both mean spin. Needed: one documented context table with tests per context.

Research §5.1.6 per-contest 3P% targets are not adopted. At σ 35 ms: open 38-41% for a league-average shooter and 48-52% elite, light 33-36%, heavy 25-29%, smothered 15-22%. The pull-up should be about 10-12% (relative) below the catch-and-shoot (NBA.com 37.4 vs 32.9). The plan's §3.3 uses its own σ 45 numbers (THR 75 open 45%), above the research band for more than the elite case it acknowledges. It never defines which THR counts as a 'league-average shooter'.

Research §5.7: fatigue should also shrink the window by up to 15%; nba-4 only shifts it. Research §5.8: On Fire should refill burst pips and add a court-edge glow. Pips arrive in nba-10, after Heat in nba-4, so no task wires the refill.

Research §5.10 'make the release pop' is not in nba-4: a one-frame hit-stop on PURE, the arc flashing green and a swish particle (render-only, via juice.ts). The engine also needs to emit contact-read events for players: a defender stumble after an elite-tier move and a big's stumble under a heavy rim contest.

NBA-27 on the owner's own device. nba-3's iOS path sends one tick for every kind, so a green and a make feel identical on iPhone. The audit's fix is two ticks about 60 ms apart for big moments, inside the gesture. The 5 s shot-clock haptic (nba-2) fires from the loop and will be dropped on iOS. Neither is stated.

NBA-14 fix 4 (timing calibration) is replaced by a bare −40…+40 ms slider that gives no feedback. A 10-tap 'tap on the beat' calibrator inside nba's own PauseMenu.tsx would meet it without touching Settings.

No first-time teaching for the new mechanics: defense controls, FT meter, pump fake and gestures, CALL radial, BOARD ring, play cards. Needed: one-time hints per device, stored in the hoops-prefs key, one line each, never covering the court. The owner asked for clear, leading UI.
No defensive feedback. Last Play / basketballFeedback explains only your own shots. On defense nothing says why the AI scored (late or early jump, 5.8 ft away, wrong look).

Online stalls. FT trips and play/look card picks in the online race need auto-resolve timeouts (for example auto-shoot after 4 s, auto-pick after 2.5 s); the plan only says 'skippable'. Without them a phone sitting on a prompt can trigger STALL_MS / GONE_MS takeovers (Arcade.tsx:70-74).

RUN is undefined for the online race. 'Three straight scores without the rival scoring' depends on asynchronous wire timing there. Specify the race version (own possessions only) so the bonus doesn't depend on the network.

No owner for score-scale handoffs. Era-aware GameCast totals (engine/broadcast.ts:181-182, uniform 206 ± 17) are 'passed to lead', but broadcast.ts has no owner in OWNERSHIP.md. Both need explicit handoffs that carry the new mean and SD per 16.

Research §5.13 UT mode ideas are deferred to ut, but STREAM-ut does not include them, so no team owns them: Top Plays/Flashbacks, Clutch mode (8 possessions + a 4-point zone), card-once Gauntlet. Flag this to the lead. nba could cheaply expose engine options (possession count, 4-point zone).

result.notes:
I revised the plan to answer the critique point by point and pushed it to claude/studio-nba (commit 58bcc10): /home/user/ps-s-nba/docs/studio-overhaul/nba-plan.md. Section 11 maps each point (M1-M27, R1-R12, K1-K21, T1-T22) to where it is handled or why it is rejected.

Structural changes:
- Defense played by default now comes right after fouls (nba-6). SWITCH/STEAL/CONTEST and the rest of defense build on it in nba-7.
- The section 3 bands are asserted once, in nba-10, after all mechanics land. nba-8 only checks local properties.
- Every task has a Must list and a cut line, so overruns cut polish, never P0 items or owner decisions.
- Online overtime and forfeit start with a design note committed before any code, plus a two-client matrix (nba-9).
- Section 5 is one controls context table: circle = spin is cut, and swipe-up dunk / swipe-down floater become automatic finish choice.

Key decisions:
1. Shooting model. The research's window sizes, its 'open green always goes in' rule and its 38-41% open-three target at sigma 35 cannot all hold. A 47 ms window alone gives about 50% greens at sigma 35. The bands are therefore asserted at sigma 50 (median human) with sigma 35 as ceilings. Elite open is accepted at 50-56% instead of 48-52%. The league-average shooter's THR is measured in nba-1, and the owner's own timing spread is measured on the phone by the calibrator.
2. HUD share. The critique's portrait numbers are inconsistent (453 of 852 px is 53%, not 55%). Bottom controls are capped at sab+190 instead, and court share is >= 55% at sat 59 and >= 52% once shell's Fix A raises it to 81.
3. Pre-1980 thr. The rating change is rejected: UT thr comes from packs' rate.ts, and packs is already re-rating every card under owner decision 5. The three-point leak is closed through era behaviour (3PA/FGA <= .05) instead.
4. Partly accepted:
   - Splitting tasks: the 10-task cap holds, so tasks were rebalanced with cut lines instead.
   - Online OT as its own task: it is nba-9's first deliverable with its own design commit, sharing the task with pause, quit and the intro.
   - Forfeit: no new wire field, but nfl's in-band 'FF' end mark is used, because the existing left/gone signals alone start an AI takeover and the quitter could win.

Cross-team contracts adopt the nfl plan's names exactly (onQuit, onFinish(..., forfeit), 'FF', onRival, userDefenseIQ(online, level), onBoxScore). I only read their plan file; I did not change anything in their worktree.

QA uses its own relay port, 7795, instead of BUILD-RULES' 7777 so it never shares a relay with another team; it is still localhost and the deviation is recorded.
